note: No queryable zoning district service found for Hickory County MO, Hermitage (county seat) or Wheatland. Hickory County is unlikely to zone unincorporated land (RSMo 64.850 requires voter approval; third-party guides say no county zoning). Hermitage publishes a zoning ordinance and use table as PDFs only (mcrpc.com ordinance, hermitage.net use table), no ArcGIS layer. Wheatland's ordinance index is not queryable. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Hickory County and zoning returned no zoning layer; the county GIS resources found are commercial parcel viewers.
